class.name: JRPGJumpToLabelCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: goes on after a label of the same page.
class.description: Goes on with the command after the label named [member label_name], looked for in the list the command is in, then in the lists around it, on the same page ([method JRPGInterpreter.jump_to_label]). Without such a label the event goes on after this command, with a warning. Authority: server.
